name: Houston Chronicle editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Houston Chronicle Lean Left. The board calls itself nonpartisan; in Harris County races its 2026 picks are 87 Democrats, 28 Republicans and 3 nonpartisan candidates, with most Republican picks in judicial races.

name: League of Women Voters of Houston
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; says it never supports or opposes candidates or parties. Publishes the Houston Voters Guide with candidates' unedited answers.

name: Houston LGBTQ+ Political Caucus (The Caucus PAC)
lean_basis: LGBTQ+ advocacy PAC. Every partisan pick on its 2026 general card is a Democrat (87 Harris County races plus 9 statewide).

name: Harris County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Publishes a roster of its Republican nominees and runs a joint campaign for Republican judicial candidates; no separate local endorsement slate found.

name: Texas Gulf Coast Area Labor Federation (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO federation of about 95 unions. The earlier-cycle endorsements still shown on its Blue Voter Guide page are all Democrats; no 2026 slate found.

name: Ground Game Texas
lean_basis: Sponsor of Houston Prop A. Runs marijuana-decriminalization and policing ballot campaigns in Texas cities and says it works on social justice issues (Texas Scorecard, FOX 26). No AllSides rating.
